title: Free Night Awards Held in One Ashbury Rewards Membership
content:
**Clause 1. Number held.** A member may hold any number of Free Night Awards of any types at the same time. There is no limit on the number of awards one member may hold.

**Clause 2. Each award stands alone.** Each award is a separate record with its own award number, expiry date and status, and is applied, released, used, expired or forfeited on its own.

**Clause 3. Awards stay with their membership.** Awards always belong to the Ashbury Rewards membership they were issued to. Where the award type's terms do not allow the award to be moved to another member's account, the award cannot be pooled with, or moved to, another member's account.

### Applying the clauses (hypothetical holdings)

| Situation | Result under the clauses |
|---|---|
| A member holds a 35K Free Night Award and two 40K Free Night Awards at once | Permitted; each of the three awards keeps its own number, expiry date and status |
| One of those awards is applied to a reservation | Only that award changes status; the other two are unaffected |
| The member asks for one award to be placed in a spouse's Ashbury Rewards account, under an award type whose terms do not allow a move to another member's account | The award stays in the member's own membership |
| Two members ask to pool their awards in one account, under such terms | Awards cannot be pooled |
